<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// Bulk-create the seed vocabulary in ONE request. Creating 10000
// terms over the REST API would be 10000 round trips; the contract's
// type-ahead latency assertion needs a vocabulary big enough that
// fetch-everything-and-filter-in-memory is visibly wrong.
for ($i = 0; $i < 10000; $i++) {
  wp_insert_term('Category ' . $i, 'category', array('slug' => 'cat-' . $i));
}
echo 'seeded';
